title: Copy Catalog Asset ID
script:
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
if game.PlaceId ~= 7041939546 then return end
const lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
const pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
pg:WaitForChild('ViewItemDetails',67)
wait()
const ItemImage = pg:WaitForChild('ViewItemDetails').Holder.Main.List.ItemDetails.ItemImage
pcall(function()
ItemImage['3DView'].AnimationPackAnimationSelector.bullshit:Destroy() end)
const dt = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ViewItemDetails.Holder.Main.List.ItemDetails.ItemImage["3DView"].AnimationPackAnimationSelector
dt:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'):Connect(function()
dt.Visible = true end)
const button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
button.Name = "bullshit"
button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,.1,0)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 37, 39)
button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
button.ImageTransparency = 1

const Img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
Img.Name = "Img"
Img.Image = 'rbxassetid://91925856574773'
Img.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.8, 0)
Img.Position = UDim2.new(.103, 0, .08, 0)
Img.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 37, 39)
Img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Img.Parent = button

button.ZIndex = 100
button.AutoButtonColor = true
button.Parent = ItemImage['3DView'].AnimationPackAnimationSelector

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.25, 0)
corner.Parent = button



local penis 

local ClientViewItemDetails = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("ClientViewItemDetails")
ClientViewItemDetails.Event:Connect(function(itemId, itemType)
	penis = itemId
end)

button.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not penis then
		setclipboard('could not be found, did you execute this while already in the dummy preview tab?')
		return
	end
setclipboard(penis)
	

end)
features:
copies whatever your currently looking at into your clipboard, just that. 
good for if you need to do the 40% discount method, or listing accessories you'll use.
works on auto execute, preferred on auto execute. please execute manually when your not on the dummy preview tab already, otherwise it wont show.
